Your role definition is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` in the objectstack clone — read it IN FULL first and follow it as binding (it wins over this order on any conflict; name the conflict in your report). Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` before your first edit (Prime Directive 14), and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read the card's full body and every comment yourself (REST: `curl -sS -X GET "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/26316" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`). ⛔ Never use a GitHub MCP tool, read or write.

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; it names your thread's branch in its `Branch:` line. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names the branch your thread was given (`claude/project-thread-…`); if no claim names it yet, send the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 one message with your branch name and wait for the claim. Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"],"labels":["skip-changeset"]}]`, draft forced); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=26316 --file=F --json` run ONCE with the output captured to a file (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`). ⛔ No other GitHub write. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names).

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Triage first grade 6427184473 (2026-10-26 20:59Z): **p3**, `bug` · `ci/cd`, `domain:skills`, `area:devpath` — 「Attribute every row to the payload's PR number and diff against the merge-base. The `merge_group` leg must stay byte-identical.」 The card's 「Wanted」 is the whole scope: on the `pull_request` leg every row is attributed to the payload's PR number (the subject is a hint at most), and the rows are the diff against the merge-base so an `origin/main` merge on the branch adds no already-landed paths; the `merge_group` leg's attribution (squash subject `(#N)`, `pullNumberFromQueueRef`) and its refusals unchanged, byte for byte. Both pinned with self-test cases on the existing battery. Nothing wider: ⛔ no change to the workflow file, to `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`, to the register or to any refusal text.

### Scope and tier

File surface: `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` only — `enumerateRows` (today L2384–L2404: `pullNumberFromSubject(commit.subject) ?? (commits.length === 1 ? fallbackPull : null)`, paths per first-parent commit by `diff-tree -m --first-parent`) and its one caller `readEventDiff` (L2746–L2747, which already computes `merge-base` but then enumerates per commit) plus the self-test battery (`--self-test`, offline). Choose the shape whose self-test can prove both negatives (an issue-numbered subject on the `pull_request` leg ⇒ the payload's PR; a branch carrying an `origin/main` merge ⇒ only the net rows) and say which in the body; keep the `merge_group` path through the same function unchanged in output for every existing case. ⛔ Not `.github/workflows/governed-surface-guard.yml`. Tier S (`scripts/pm/**`, the seat-protocol surface): the seat lands it after the contract review PASS and its own `## 席位核对` — you never ready, arm, enqueue or approve (os-dev.md rule 2). Tier of your thread: `dispatch-gates --tier scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` prints no path mandate; the seat derived the ceiling tier under the maintainer's standing word for this lane and set effort `high` for an S-size card on the queue's enforcement file — the seat's claim carries both.

### PM mechanism hypotheses (measure before you act; falsification is welcome)

Read-only premise check on `origin/main` at `3fcafcd3` (seat, 2026-10-27T06:40Z): **holds, with one reading.**
1. The card's `enumerateRows` description holds: subject first, payload fallback only when the range is one commit (L2398). Reading: `readEventDiff` already diffs from `merge-base(base, head)` (L2746), so the merge-base is NOT the missing piece — the per-commit `diff-tree --first-parent` on a merge commit of `origin/main` is what adds main's already-landed paths (the card's 141-path measurement on #26311). The fix is the enumeration (one row per commit vs the net diff on the `pull_request` leg), not a new merge-base call; the self-test must build a tiny git fixture or an injected `git` seam to prove it — read how the existing battery fakes git before choosing.
2. `resolveEventContext` (L1067–L1077) already carries `namedPull: Number(pull.number)` for `pull_request` and `pullNumberFromQueueRef(group.head_ref)` for `merge_group`; `queuedPullsInGroup` (L1996) and `runSizeGuard` (L2104) read `namedPull` — the `merge_group` leg must keep its multi-PR decomposition (the header on why the group is decomposed rather than keyed to `head_ref`).
3. The self-test pins its battery roster by NAME with a per-battery assertion floor (#13489, L585 ff.): add your cases inside the existing attribution/enumeration batteries and raise those batteries' floors by measurement in the same PR, say so. The workflow runs `--self-test` first in its own step (L145) and the guard at L268; `package.json` carries no alias for this file — the local gate is `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` plus whatever `dispatch-gates --commands` derives.
4. Serial: no open PR touches `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (scan at 2026-10-27T06:40Z); last landings on the file are the enqueue-limb and provenance rounds (#26230, #26201); base on a tree carrying `3fcafcd3` or later.

### Card-specific clauses

- Gates: derive with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) on your final tree, run each locally (exit code captured before any pipe), reconcile with `--ran`; the guard's `--self-test` must carry the two new cases named in the ruling and the `merge_group` cases byte-identical in output (diff the battery's output before and after and quote it); long gates detached under `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` with `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT=issue-26316`. ⛔ Do not wait for CI after the PR opens — but the PR's own `pull_request` run of the guard IS the card's live acceptance; read its check-run output once it finishes and quote the attribution line in a follow-up report if it finished after your report.
- PR body: line 1 `Fixes #26316` (behind the harness's two attribution lines), then `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial, the six-line `## 维护者速读` exactly as `os-dev.md` 285–289 require (Tier S: 需要你做的 = 无,席位落地), then What changes, Tests (the two new self-test cases named, the floor arithmetic), Acceptance notes (the card's three acceptance lines answered), Verification (the guard's `pull_request` output on PR #25965-shaped and #26311-shaped fixtures, before and after, quoted). ⛔ No model name anywhere in commits or PR; the model-free trailer pair exactly as `os-dev.md` / `AGENTS.md` spell them.
- ⛔ Never write the card's labels or assignee. ⛔ No GitHub MCP tools, reads included.
- Final report: the JSON exactly per `os-dev.md` (issue comment on #26316 whose first line is `os-dev-report`, then the same JSON as your hand-back message to the seat thread), with `deviations` and `out_of_scope_findings` (class + reach + evidence + dedupe words + carrier). Hand back: one message to the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 naming the PR number, the head sha, the report comment id and the premise verdict; then stay subscribed to the PR for the contract review's verdict and a possible patch round.
